war_summary: War 139 is on day 89 with no winner yet. The map is heavily polarized: Colonials hold 136 strategic bases across 24 regions (mostly rear/central areas), while Wardens hold 73 bases across 10 regions concentrated in the north/west (Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Oarbreaker, Olavis Wake, Onyx, Speaking Woods, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse). Only 5 regions show mixed ownership. Recent combat is intense in several Warden-held regions: Callahans Passage (~2k casualties/2h), Clahstra (~1.8k/2h), Dead Lands (~1.7k/2h), Endless Shore (~1.3k/2h), Olavis Wake (~2.1k/2h), Onyx (~1.2k/2h), Speaking Woods (~1.5k/2h). These areas also show accelerating 2h-vs-prior casualty trends and high enlistment surges, indicating active frontlines. Ownership changes in the last 24h are confirmed in Clahstra (19 events, 3 bases hot), Endless Shore (8 events, 2 bases), Mooring County (20 events, 5 bases), Oarbreaker (26 events, 5 bases), Olavis Wake (8 events, 3 bases), Onyx (14 events, 5 bases), Stlican Shelf (20 events, 5 bases), and smaller activity in Morgens Crossing, Stema Landing, Tempest Island. The next 24h will likely see continued base flips in these contested zones, especially where Warden-held bases face sustained Colonial pressure.
